LESSON: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.6: Attributes of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Attributes of God. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God
2. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Attributes of God helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD
Study Attributes of God like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read scriptures on the attributes of God

What this means
In this part you learn to read scriptures on the attributes of God. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read scriptures on the attributes of God.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Attributes of God” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read scriptures on the attributes of God. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Attributes of God in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Attributes of God is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Attributes of God” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read scriptures on the attributes of God)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Attributes of God in your own words. (skill: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Attributes of God to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read scriptures on the attributes of God.
3. Practise this skill: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Attributes of God from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Attributes of God: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Attributes of God?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Attributes of God means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read scriptures on the attributes of God.
5. Be able to: recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
